task: Causal prediction of seven cued movement velocities from human intracortical recordings
adaptation_split: First chronological held-out-calib recording block on each later day
evaluation_split: Second chronological held-out-calib recording block on each later day, reserved before reading targets
selection: Forward-day validation on held-in days: train on all preceding days, beginning with three training days. Choose base regularization by frozen validation performance, then per-method regularization independently for each calibration budget. Choose the primary candidate by held-in validation mean R2 at 30 seconds. Save selection before opening any held-out-calib targets. Amendment after reused-data reevaluation: the source-only alpha of the primary candidate failed to transfer to later days, so its 30-second adaptation alpha was reselected from previously observed later-day results (reused_data_alpha_overrides). That override is leaderboard-informed, recorded in the selection file, and every later-day result is labeled reused-data evidence rather than a fresh holdout.
calibration: Take the chronological prefix of the first held-out-calib recording block for each day. The entire second block is reserved for evaluation. Budgets include every observed bin, including rest/cue periods; fit supervised methods only on official eval_mask bins with finite targets. Never select target days, windows, or channels using evaluation labels.
scoring: Variance-weighted R2 across seven outputs using official eval_mask. Concatenate recording blocks within each day, then macro-average day scores. Report every day, every method, every budget, negative scores, and per-output scores.
filter_boundaries: Reset causal filter at each NWB recording boundary. No future neural samples, evaluation-derived normalization, target-derived features, or smoothing across files.
scope: Offline local chronological-block holdout on one deidentified human participant; not official minival or hidden-test evaluation, live closed-loop control, clinical validation, or a novelty claim. The public release has no held-out-minival files. Dataset dates are obfuscated.
stop_condition: If source-selected targeted repair does not beat matched recalibration baselines on the untouched later-day evaluation, report that failure. Original ruling: no tuning on those evaluation labels. Amended ruling (2026-10-06): exactly one disclosed leaderboard-informed reselection was performed on the previously observed later-day results (reused_data_alpha_overrides); no other later-day tuning is permitted, and all later-day results remain labeled reused-data evidence. No claim that decompilation contributes unless an explicit ablation demonstrates it.
